title: West Bengal Legislative Assembly 2026 (holdout)

AITC.note: contesting essentially alone (291 of 294), per frozen rev 2026-03-26

BJP.note: contesting 293; ISF seat-sharing 'yet to be finalized' at freeze - ISF (1.39 in 2021) NOT included

LF.note: Left Front WITHOUT INC (2021 Sanyukta Morcha dissolved); CPIML joined (10 seats) - was outside in 2021, tau transfer. GE2024: only CPM registers a share in state_shares_all

INC.note: INC contesting all 294 alone per frozen rev; own-vote baseline (2.97 AE2021, 4.72 GE2024) - both earned under Left-INC seat adjustment, so solo baseline may overstate

poll_corrections.rule: 0.5 x mean of WB ledger errors (actual - final-window polled), WB2021 only: AITC 48.64-42.03=+6.61 -> +3.3; BJP 38.85-37.93=+0.92 -> +0.46. LF/INC: no 2026 poll split exists (merged 13-15% cell in frozen rev) and the 2021 SM error (-7.2) belongs to a bloc that no longer exists -> 0

quality_flags: Both pre-freeze polls are unrated agencies (IANS-Matrize, VoteVibe CNN-News18); M3 runs at inflated sigma 6.0.

LF+ and INC have NO separate poll numbers at freeze (Wikipedia table merges LF+/INC/Others into one 13-15% colspan cell) -> their questions are M3-blind (WATCH-NOPOLL) and the M3 seat sim excludes them, which mechanically inflates AITC/BJP M3 seat counts; the dual gate's min() partially protects.
BJP-ISF seat sharing unresolved at freeze; ISF excluded from BJP bloc.
Baseline AE (WB2021) covers 290 of 294 ACs in ae_long; seat sims run on 290.
2021 WB polls underestimated AITC by 6.6 pts; correction +3.3 applied per ledger rule.
